spans.s:
(ऋ) वणृ r. 1st cl. (वणति)
To sound; also वन.

m. (-णः)
1 An arrow.
2 A name of fire.
3 The name of a sovereign considered also as an Asura or infernal being, the son of BĀLĪ, and destroyed by VIṢṆ

The udder of a cow.
5 Alone, solitary.
6 A pipe, a fife, a flute.
mf. (-णः-णा)
1 Blue

Barleria.
2

The root or feathered part of an arrow.
E.
वण or बण to sound or go, aff. घञ्; whence this word and other derivatives are sometimes also written with an initial ब.

r. 10th cl. (वण्टयति)
To partition, to separate or divide; also वटि.

m. (-ण्टः)
1 A part, a portion.
2 A man unmarried.
3 The handle of a sickle.
E.
वटि to divide, aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
A part, a portion, a share.
E.
वटि to divide, घञ् and कन् aff.

n. (-नं)
Portioning, partitioning, dividing.
E.
वटि to divide, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Divisible, to be divided.
E.
वटि to divide, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-ण्ठः)
1 An unmarried man.
2 A dwarf.
3 A javelin.
E.
वठि to go alone, aff. घञ्.

m. (-रः)
1 The new shoot of the Tāla or palm tree.
2 The sheath that envelopes the young bambu.
3 A rope for tying a goat, &c.
4 A breast.
5 A dog's tail.
6 A dog.
7 A cloud.
E.
वठि to go alone, aff. अरच्.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
1 Maimed, defective, crippled, but especially in the hands.
2 Impotent, emasculated.
m. (-ण्डः)
1 A man who is circumcised or has no prepuce.
2 An ox without his tail.
f. (-ण्डः)
An unchaste woman.
E.
वण to sound, &c., aff. ड.

m. (-रः)
1 A niggard, a miser.
2 A eunuch or attendant on the woman's apartments.

m. (-लः)
1 A description of conflict, the contest of heroes.
2 A boat.
3 A spade, a hoe.
E.
वडि to divide, आलच् aff.

m. (-ण्डः)
A weaver's loom.
E.
वाण an arrow, and दण्ड a stick.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pierced, wounded by an arrow.
E.
वाण, and निकृत hurt.

mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि)
Armed with arrows.
E.
वाण, and पाणि the hand.

n. (-रं)
The capital of VĀṆA Rāja.
E.
वाण, and पुर city; also with the final consonant वाणपुर्. f. (-पूः)

n. (-णं)
Shooting an arrow.
E.
वाण, and मोक्षण letting fly.

Armour.
2

A breastplate, a cuirass.
E.
वाण an arrow, वृ to cover or screen, aff. घञ्.

f. (-ता)
UṢĀ, the daughter of VĀṆA, and wife of ANIRUDDHA.
E.
वाण, and सुता daughter.

m. (-हा)
VIṢṆU.
E.
वाण VĀṆA Rāja, and हन् destroyer.

m. (-रिः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
वाण the demon, and अरि an enemy.

m. (-यः)
A bow.
E.
वाण an arrow, and आश्रय receptacle.

n. (-नं)
A bow.
E.
वाण an arrow, असन throwing, or आसन a seat.

Weaving.
2

A species of the Aṣṭī metre.
E.
वण to sound, aff. इनि.

f. (-णी)
1 SARASVATĪ, the goddess of speech.
2 Speech, sound.
E.
वण to sound, aff. इञ्, and ङीप् or ङीष् added.

n. (-ज्यं)
Traffic, trade: see वाणिज्य.

mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि)
1 Having an arrow.
2 Speaking.
f. (-नी)
1 A sharp or clever woman, an intriguing woman.
2 An actress, a dancer, a Nāc girl.
3 A furious woman, one literally or figuratively intoxicated.
E.
वाण an arrow, or वाणि speech, इनि and ङीप् affs.
